frame.restingText: Bekaa dash gaa-izhi-gichi. Ezhichigeyan gaa-ayaad ezhi-gii-bekaayan.
frame.placeText: Gii-bekaa-ayaa dash biinish gaa-ziibaakwaa. Ezhiwebak maajiigaadeg, ingiw bimaadiziwin dash maajiigaadeg.

pairs.allTogether: All pairs together. Play again or take a break.
pairs.mismatch: Take your time. Tap a picture to continue.
pairs.mismatchNamed: {a} and {b}. Take your time. Tap a picture to continue.

picturePairs.guidanceShowing: Tap a picture, then tap the one that matches it.
picturePairs.guidanceHidden: Tap two tiles to turn them over. Look for two the same.
picturePairs.dayHelp: Gaa-izhi-giizhig gaa-ayaajig mazinaatesijig ingiw. Ezhi-giizhig ezhi-giizhig gaa-ayaanaan, gaawiin dash gaa-ayaanaan ezhi-giizhigan.
picturePairs.guidanceDaily: Giizhigad mazinaatesijig niiwin nisidotaaganan. Gigii-nagamon mazinaatesi, dash gaa-nagamon gaa-ezhi-giiwed.
picturePairs.calendarHelp: Ezhi-giizhig gaa-ayaajig niiwin mazinaatesijig ingiw. Gaawiin gaa-nagamowin, dash gaawiin giizhig gaa-gichi-bekaa.
picturePairs.calendarVersion: Gaa-izhi-ezhiwebak {date}. Mazinaatesijig gaa-ayaajig ingiw giizhig ezhi-giizhigan.

choose.thatOne: That one is the {name|lower}. Take your time.

findTheSame.guidance: Look at the picture at the top. Tap the same one below.

shadowMatch.guidance: Look at the shadow at the top. Tap the picture that makes it.

fourTogether.guidance: Gigii-nagamon {n} mazinaatesijig gaa-ayaajig ingiw, dash gigii-nagamon minwaa miinawaa.
fourTogether.elsewhere: {name|lower} gaa-ayaad ezhi-gaa-ayaajig ingiw dash. Bekaa sa.

oddOneOut.guidance: Gigii-nagamon mazinaatesi gaa-gaawiin ezhi-gaa-ayaasii ingiw, dash gigii-nagamon.

seatedToss.guidance: Gii-bekaa-ayaa ogaa-maajiigaadeg gii-wiindamaagewin gaa-ayaajig. Gigii-gaa-zhiiwitaa miinawaa gaa-ayaajig ezhi-giiwed, ziibaakwadoon dash giigaanaajig.
steps: Gaa-ziibaakwaadeg dash gaa-ezhi-gaa-ayaajig giigaanaajig, miinawaa gaa-ayaajig wiigwaam bekaa dash ingiw.
Bekaa sa, gaa-ayaajig niiwin. Gaa-maajiigaadeg, gigii-nagamon biinish gaa-ayaajig, gaawiin gaa-bekaa-ayaasii.
Gaa-ayaajig giigaanaajig gaa-ayaajig ezhi-gaa-ayaasii, gigii-zhaawanaakwaa gaa-nagamon gaa-ayaajig.
Gigii-ginwaabi ingiw gaa-bekaa-ayaa, gaawiin gegoo gaa-gichi-gaa-izhichigesii.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Gii-zhiwebak wiigwaam gaa-ayaajig giigaanaajig, bekaa sa dash, gaawiin gaa-zhiiwitaasii ojiishiwan, dash gaa-ayaad ayaa gaa-ayaanaan ogiigaanan. Gaa-ayaajig biinish gaa-ayaad ezhi-gaa-ayaasii.
safety: Gii-zhiwebak wiigwaam gaa-ayaajig giigaanaajig, gaa-ayaajig gaa-biidaasiwin. Gaa-ayaajig dash gaa-ginwaabi, gaawiin gaa-ayaasii dash.
Bemaadizijig gaa-ayaajig biinish gaa-ayaasii gaa-bagidinaagigoojig. Gaa-ayaajig gaawiin ezhi-gaa-ayaasii gaa-ayaanaan ogiigaanan.
Gaa-bekaa-ayaa. Gaa-zhiiwitaa biinish, gaa-ayaad ingiw giigaanaajig, gaawiin ezhi-zhiiwitaasii ojiishiwan.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Gaa-ayaajig gaa-ziibaakwaadeg: niswi giigaanaajig, ezhi-ayaajig Near, Middle dash Far, gaa-ayaajig wiigwaam gaa-ayaajig ingiw dash.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Lay the sheet flat between you. When a toss lands in a ring, tick a box in your column, on that ring's row.

seasonalPack.guidance: Gaa-ayaajig giizis, gaa-ziibaakwaadeg niswi gaa-ayaajig ezhi-gaa-ayaajig, miinawaa gaa-nagamon biinish, niswi, gaa-ayaajig ingiw.
seasonalPack.monthNote: Gaa-ayaajig giizis gaa-ayaad ezhi-gaa-ayaajig mazinaatesijig. Gaa-ayaajig ezhi-gaa-ayaasii giizis gaa-ayaad ezhi-gaa-ayaajig.
seasonalPack.restLine: Gaawiin gaa-ayaajig niiwin giizhig. Giizhig gaa-bekaa-ayaa gaa-ayaad ezhi-giizhig.

pairs.title: Gaa-ezhi-gaa-ayaajig ingiw
pairs.how: Gaa-ayaajig wiigwaam gaa-ayaad mazinaatesi, gaa-ayaajig ingiw gaa-ayaad mazinaatesi.
pairs.describe: Niiwin gaa-ayaajig mazinaatesijig, gaa-ayaajig ezhi-gaa-ayaajig ingiw.

different.title: Gaa-ayaad gaawiin ezhi-gaa-ayaasii?
different.how: Gaa-zhaawanaakwaa mazinaatesi gaa-ayaad gaawiin ezhi-gaa-ayaasii ingiw niswi.
different.describe: Niiwin mazinaatesijig gaa-ayaajig. Niswi ezhi-gaa-ayaajig, biinish gaawiin.

color.title: Gaa-ziibaakwaadeg
color.how: Gaa-ziibaakwaadeg mazinaatesi ezhi-gaa-ayaajig, gaa-ayaajig giigaanaajig dash gaa-ayaajig.

seasonalPack.sheetHow: Gaa-ziibaakwaadeg biinish. Gaa-nagamon niswi, niiwin, gaa-ayaajig ezhi-gaa-ayaajig.
seasonalPack.printFooter: Gaa-nagamon niswi, niiwin, dash gaa-ayaajig. Gaa-bekaa-ayaa gaa-ayaad ezhi-giiwed.

decorateACard.guidance: Gaa-ayaajig wiindamaagewin, gigii-ziibaakwaadeg wiigwaam gaa-ayaajig giigaanaajig dash gaa-ayaajig. Gaawiin gaa-ayaasii wiigwaam ezhi-gaa-ayaajig.

steps.fold: Gaa-ziibaakwaadeg wiigwaam dash gaa-ayaad giigaanaajig ezhi-giiwed gaa-ayaajig, gaa-ayaajig ojiishiwan.
steps.front: Gaa-ayaad ezhi-gaa-ayaajig gaa-ayaajig ojiishiwan, ingiw gaa-ayaajig.
steps.inside: Gaa-ayaad ayaa gaa-ayaajig gaa-ayaajig ozhibii'igan, dash gaa-ayaajig ezhi-gaa-ayaajig.
steps.message: Write a message together. One person can write while the other says the words.
steps.stop: Gaa-bekaa-ayaa gaa-ayaad ezhi-giiwed. Gaawiin gegoo wiigwaam ezhi-gaa-ayaajig, dash biinish ezhi-gaa-ayaajig.

decorateACard.materials: Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. Nothing needs cutting, gluing or sticking.
decorateACard.previewLabel: Gaa-ayaajig wiigwaam gaa-ziibaakwaadeg niswi. Ojiishiwan gaa-ayaad {words}, dash gaa-ayaajig giigaanaajig. Ingiw gaa-ayaad wiindamaagewin dash gaa-ayaajig From.
decorateACard.sheetHow: Biinakwaadaa mazinaakizigan gaa-nakwaajiged, dasing-ayaanid waabandaan. Dibaajimo mazinaakizigan niigaan-ayaanid.
sheetRules: Ezhi-gaa-bi-gikinaagoziwaad, dash ezhi-zhiwebad: bemaadizid ezhi-miinaa niigaan, endaso bemaadizid giiwe-zhigaa.
Dibaajimo mazinaakizigan ezhi-bi-kiiwebak, dash bemaadizid ezhi-gikinaa gaa-dibaajimod.

storyDice.guidance: Ganawaabamaadaan mazinaakiziganan miinwaa dibaajimo dibaajimowin iwidi, ezhi-gaa-ayaang. Gaawiin dibaajimowin ezhi-gaa-wiinwi.
storyDice.passed: Gaa-wiinwaa ezhi-gii-ayaa. Wiinwi-bemaadizid gaa-ezhi-ganawaa, endaso ezhi-gaa-dibaashkobijigan.

wordPicture.guidance: Ganawaabamaadaan mazinaakizigan, dash ezhi-ganawaabamaad dibaajimowin gaa-ezhi-ayaanid. Endaso ganawaabamaadaan dibaajimowin, dash mazinaakizigan ezhi-gaa-gikendaan.

colorMatch.guidance: Ganawaabamaadaan miskwaa miinwaa dibaajimowin gaa-ezhi-ayaad, endaso ganawaabamaad mazinaakiziganan ezhi-gaa-ayaad miskwaa.

halvesMatch.guidance: Ganawaabamaad biidaasijigan giiwe-ayaad, endaso ganawaabamaad biidaasijigan niigaan ezhi-gaa-ayaad.

colorByNumber.guidance: Gaa-ganawaa miskwaa gaa-ezhi-ayaad, endaso bebezhig-zhaawaa-wiigiwaan miskwaa-ayaa. Ginwi miskwaa ezhi-gaa-ayaa.
colorByNumber.sheet: Ginwi zhaawaa ezhi-gaa-ayaad miskwaa gaa-nambiiyaad. Ezhi-ayaad mazinaakizigan gaa-wiidookaaged: {name}.
colorByNumber.own: Ginwi zhaawaa ezhi-miskwaa. Ezhi-ayaad mazinaakizigan gaa-ezhi-gii-ganawaad.
colorByNumber.filledAll: Ginwi gaawiin ezhi-miskwaa zhaawaa ezhi-gaa-ayaad miskwaa gaa-nambiiyaad.

patternMaker.guidance: Ganawaabamaad zhaawaa ezhi-zhiwebak miskwaa. Ezhi-gaa-ayaad dibaajimowin gaa-zhaawaa. Gaawiin wenji-gaa-aanji-ezhi-gaa-gaa-ayaad.

buildTogether.guidance: Bebezhig-gaa-zhaawaa, zhaawaa ezhi-gaa-ayaad. Miskwaa gaa-ezhi-ayaad gii-gaa-ayaad. Gaawiin wenji-gaa-aanji-ezhi-gaa-ayaad.
buildTogether.taken: Bezhig-gaa-zhaawaa {row}, niizh-gaa-zhaawaa {column} gii-ayaa dibaajimowin. Gaa-wiindamaa gaawiin ezhi-miskwaa zhaawaa.
buildTogether.sheetHelp: Wiinwi-gaa-ganawaa. Gaa-zhaawaa-zhaawaa, bemaadizid gaa-ezhi-gaa-zhaawaad miskwaa gaa-ayaad.

quietShapes.guidance: Ganawaabamaad biidaasijigan, endaso ganawaabamaad zhaawaa mazinaakizigan iwidi ezhi-gaa-ayaad. Gaawiin wenji-gaa-aanji-ezhi-gaa-ayaad.
quietShapes.outlineLabel: Gaa-ezhi-ayaad {picture}. Ganawaabamaad zhaawaa, gaa-zhiwebak biidaasijigan gaa-wiindamaa.
quietShapes.spaceFilled: Zhaawaa {n}, {shape}, gaa-zhaawaa biidaasij. Ganawaabamaad gaa-zhiwebak biidaasij.
quietShapes.chosen: {piece} gaa-wiindamaa. Sa-naa ganawaabamaad zhaawaa mazinaakizigan iwidi.
quietShapes.different: Ezhiwebak bagijigan oodi gaawiin gaa-wiiyaashkiinan aanzhi. Ginoonde aanzhi ezhichigeyin.
quietShapes.filled: Aanzhi oodi gaa-izhichigesiin bagijigan. Gaa-ziigwebinaan bagijigan ezhi-ginawaabamaad.
quietShapes.cleared: Bagijiganan ayaa bigwaakwaanan. Gaa-ziibiing igo ge-ni-gaa-nisidotamaan, gii-ni-ziibiing.
quietShapes.sheetHow: Ziigaabiing bagijiganan, ayaa gaa-bizindamaan ezhichigesiin bagijiganan. Ogii-gaa-piindigaadaan niigaan ezhiwebak wiiyaas ayaa aabjiyaan.

picnicPlanner.guidance: Tap a picture to put it in the picnic basket, and tap it in the basket to take it out. The basket holds six things.
picnicPlanner.guidancePlay: Ziigwebin niizh dibaajimowin mino-ezhichigeyan. Dibaajimowin ayaa ginwaabamaad, gaawiin nibaadaawin.
picnicPlanner.already: {picture} ayaa igo wiigwaaskaadiwigaanan. Ziigwebin igo ji-bizindamaan.
picnicPlanner.notice: Gaa-dibaajimotaagan ji-dibaajimoyan. Gaawiin nibaadaawin, gaawiin ginoonde-dazhindaan, gaawiin gaa-ziibiiginaan.
picnicPlanner.sheetHow: Ziigaabiing ezhi-bagidinaan gaa-ezhichigeyan. Ogii-gaa-piindigaadaan wiinawaa ezhiwebak ji-ayaang ezhi-bagidinaan.

scrapbook.guidanceEmpty: Izhaayan niizh ata niizh-midaaswi gaa-ziigwebinaan gaa-ziibiiginaan ji-zhaabwii-naagadawenimaad.
scrapbook.guidance: Mino-ziibaabiigejimang nikiwaan ziigwebinan, ziigwebin dibaajimowin, aabiding dash naagaanaak. Bekish ezhiwebak nikiwaan ayaa dibaajimowin. Gaawiin igo ezhichigesiin gaa-ziigwebinaan ayaa mashkawaaken.
scrapbook.intro: Izhaayan niizh ata niizh-midaaswi gaa-ziigwebinaan wiigwaasikaan. Ezhi-bagidinaan ayaa nikiwaan ji-zhaabwii-naagadawenimaad.
scrapbook.consent: Ezhichigeyan nidaa-nikiwaan. Gaa-ziibiing ezhichigeyan ayaa mindimooyeyaan wiinawaa gaawiin ezhi-dibaajimoyan.
scrapbook.privacy: Nikiwaan ayaa wiigwaasikaan. Gaawiin ezhi-izhaayan, gaawiin ezhi-bagidinaan.
scrapbook.cleared: Nikiwaan ayaa gaa-ziigwaabamaad. Izhaayan ziigwebinan ji-zhaabwii-naagadawenimaad.
scrapbook.captionLabel: Ᏸᑭ ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ ᑳ ᓂᓈᐱᓂ ᐊᐦ ᑭᐦᑳᒥᐠ
scrapbook.captionHelp: Ᏸᑭ ᓂᒋᐦᑖᑲᓂ 80 ᒪᑭᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ. Ᏸᑭ ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ ᑳ ᓂᓈᐱᓂ ᐊᐦ ᑭᐦᑳᒥᐠ ᑭ ᐊᐦᑳᐦᑖᑲᓂ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ.
scrapbook.sheetHow: ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ. ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ ᑳ ᓂᓈᐱᓂ ᐊᐦ ᑭᐦᑳᒥᐠ.
scrapbook.sheetEmpty: Ᏸᑭ ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ ᑳ ᓂᓈᐱᓂ ᐊᐦ ᑭᐦᑳᒥᐠ.
scrapbook.sheetWords: A few words for this page

skipped.one: {n} ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ ᑳ ᓂᓈᐱᓂ ᐊᐦ ᑭᐦᑳᒥᐠ.
skipped.other: {n} ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ ᑳ ᓂᓈᐱᓂ ᐊᐦ ᑭᐦᑳᒥᐠ.

quietScene.guidance: ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭᒋᒧᐎᓐ ᐋᐱᓂᐦᑭᓂᓂᐠ ᐊᐦ ᑭᐦᑳᒥᐠ. Ᏸᑭ ᐊᓂᑭᓂᐦᑖᑲᓂᐠ ᑭ ᐊᐦᑳᐦᑖᑲᓂ.

lines.sunrise: The sun is coming up over the land.
lines.vase-of-flowers: A vase of flowers on the table.
lines.teacup: A cup of tea by the window.
lines.tree: A tree standing in the garden.
lines.moon: The moon in the night sky.
lines.daisies: A patch of daisies in the grass.
lines.rowing-boat: A rowing boat on still water.
lines.potted-plant: A green plant in a pot.

collageBoard.guidance: Take turns. Tap a cut-out, then tap an empty place to put it there. Nothing you make is saved or sent.
collageBoard.tookBack: The piece is taken back. Your turn, {person|lower}.
collageBoard.tookBackPass: The pass is taken back. Your turn, {person|lower}.
collageBoard.restarted: The board is empty. Your turn, {person|lower}.

gardenPlanner.guidance: Tap a picture, then tap a bed to put it there. Tap a bed that has a picture, with nothing chosen, to clear it.
gardenPlanner.needPicture: Ganawaabandan dibaakwegan ezhiwebak, miinwaa tap ginwaabikan.
gardenPlanner.cleared: Ginwaabikan {n} giiwen. Ezhi-gwaashkwaa, ganawaabandan dibaakwegan ishkwaa.
gardenPlanner.sheetHow: Ginwaabikanan ganawaabandaan dibaakwegan gaa-zhaaganaak ekwe. Ezhi-gaabaanaan ginwaabikanan giigoonag, mino.
gardenPlanner.notice: Ganawaabandan dibaakwegan ezhiwebak, gaawiin ganawaabandiwin ezhi-miigaaning.

coloringWall.guidance: Gaa-zhaaganaak dibaakwegan miinwaa ziigwan. Makwaadinaan wiiyaas, miinwaa ningodwaak bemaadiz mashkawaazhig ziigwan ningodwaak niizh. Gaawiin gaa-gizhaanaan, gaawiin gaa-ganawaabandaan, gaawiin gaa-zhaaganaan.
coloringWall.previewLabel: {picture|lower} gaa-zhaaganaak {n} ziigwan, {across} ayaa wiiyaas miinwaa {down} ayaa giiyaan. Ziigwan ningodwaak ayaa ogaawaatig ziigwan aandi.
coloringWall.labelsNote: Ogaawaatig giiyaan ayaa dibaakwegan, miinwaa giigoonag wiiyaas ayaa, ezhi-A1 ayaa ziigwan giiwedin.
steps: Makwaadinaan giigoonag ziigwan. Ziigwan ningodwaak ayaa ezhi-gaabaanaan miinwaa mapa wiiyaas.
Ningodwaak bemaadiz gaa-zhaaganaak ziigwan niizh miinwaa mashkawaazhig.
Mashkawaaziin miinwaa gaa-ezhiwebak gaawiin gaa-zhaaganaan. Ziigwan ningodwaak ayaa dibaakwegan ningodwaak.
Gaa-ganawaabandaan ziigwan ogaawaatig, dash gaa-tapinaan ziigwan gaa-zhaaganaak.
coloringWall.mapLabel: Mapa wiiyaas: {down} giigoonag ziigwan {across}, ogaawaatig A1 miinwaa {last}.
coloringWall.edgeNote: Nagaachige-giiyaan ayaa ziigwan gaa-ayaad. Gaa-zhaaganaak ziigwan giiyaan, miinwaa gaa-ganawaabandaan mino.
coloringWall.pictureLine: Dibaakwegan: {picture}. Ekwe wiiyaas ayaa {n} ziigwan: {across} wiiyaas miinwaa {down} giiyaan.

findTogether.guidance: Gaa-kiiwenzo. Ezhi-kiiwenzo, ginwaabikan niizh ziigwan miinwaa gaa-ganawaabandaan waawiyaan. Ganawaabandaan waawiyaan ningodwaak.
findTogether.different: {a} miinwaa {b} gaawiin waawiyaasiin. Mino-ganawaabandan, sago gwaashkwaa.
findTogether.waiting: Gwaashkwaa ezhi-ni-gaa-kiiwenzo ginwaabikan. Ekwe kiiwenzo waa-kiiwenzo.

drawingDuet.guidance: Kiiwenzo ningodwaak giigoon, miinwaa gaa-zhaaganaak mashkawaazhigan. Ogii-gaawiin ezhi-kiiwenziin. Gaawiin gaa-makwaadinaan. Dibaakwegan ayaa ezhi-gaabaanaan gaa-makwaadinaan.
drawingDuet.keys: Mashkiigan-ganawaabandan ayaa gaa-zhaaganaak mashkawaazhigan dibaakwegan. Ziigwan ayaa gaa-zhaaganaak mashkawaazhigan ginwaabiyaan miinwaa wiiyaas.
drawingDuet.restarted: Ziigwan giiwen. Ningodwaak bemaadiz ayaa kiiwenzo. Gwaashkwaa ishkwaa dash gaawiin gaa-zhaaganaan.
drawingDuet.saved: Dibaakwegan ayaa ezhi-gaabaanaan. Gaa-zhaaganaak download-link ezhi-gaabaanaan ekwe miigaan.
drawingDuet.paperRules: Niizh bemaadiz, ningodwaak ziigwan, niizh mashkawaazhigan. Ningodwaak kiiwenzo ningodwaak giigoon miinwaa shape, dash gwaashkwaa mashkawaazhigan. Gaawiin gaa-ezhi-gaa-ganawaabandaan wiiyaas dibaakwegan.

colorWash.guidance: Gaa-zhaaganaak mashkawaaziin ziigwan, ningodwaak wash ishkwaa. Gaa-ginwaabiyaan brush gaa-gwaashkwaa, miinwaa gaa-ezhiwebak aanjibiigan. Gaawiin gaa-makwaadinaan gaawiin gaa-zhaaganaan.
colorWash.keys: Mashkiigan-ganawaabandan ayaa gaa-zhaaganaak brush ring ziigwan. Ziigwan ayaa gaa-zhaaganaak brush ginwaabiyaan miinwaa wiiyaas.

sortTogether.guidance: Tap a picture, then tap the basket it belongs in.
sortTogether.selected: {name}. Now tap the basket it goes in.
sortTogether.pickFirst: First tap a picture, then tap a basket.
sortTogether.hint: The {name|lower} could go in "{basket}". Tap that basket to put it there.
sortTogether.sorted: Everything is sorted. Look through the baskets together, or try another theme.
sortTogether.largerOn: Gichitaa ziigwan gaa-ayaad. Gaawiin dibaakwegan gaa-zhaaganaak.
sortTogether.largerOff: Gichitaa ziigwan gaawiin ayaasiin. Gaawiin dibaakwegan gaa-zhaaganaak.
sortTogether.largerOnNewRound: Gichitaa ziigwan gaa-ayaad, niizh basket. Ekwe dibaakwegan ishkwaa ganawaabandaan.

picturePuzzle.guidance: Tap one piece, then tap another. They swap places.
picturePuzzle.pickedUp: Piece picked up. Now tap where it should go.
picturePuzzle.whole: The {name|lower} is whole again. Choose another picture whenever you like.

swapped.one: Swapped. {correct} of {total} piece is in place.
swapped.other: Swapped. {correct} of {total} pieces are in place.

picturePuzzle.guideText: This is how the picture looks when it is whole.
picturePuzzle.ownPrivacy: Nimiigwaan ayaa ezhi-gaabaanaan ekwe. Gaawiin gaa-makwaadinaan miinwaa gaawiin gaa-zhaaganaan.
picturePuzzle.ownConsent: Gaa-zhaaganaak nimiigwaan. Gaa-gii-kiiwenzo ogii-kaawiyaan ezhi-ganawaabandan bemaadiz gaawiin gii-kanaan gaa-kiiwenziin.
picturePuzzle.ownNotUsable: Gaa-zhaaganaak giigoonag gaawiin ezhi-gaabaanaan. Gaa-ganawaabandaan dibaakwegan giigoonag, ekwe JPEG miinwaa PNG.
picturePuzzle.ownWhole: Nimiigwaan ayaa giiwen ishkwaa. Gaa-zhaaganaak ishkwaa ezhi-gaabaanaan whenever gaa-kiiwenzo.
picturePuzzle.ownSheetHow: Gaa-giigoonag gaa-zhaaganaak nagaachige-giiyaan. Gaa-zhaaganaak ziigwan, dash gaa-zhaaganaak niizh ziigwan ningodwaak miinwaa dibaakwegan giiwen.
picturePuzzle.done: The picture is whole again. Play again or take a break.

finishTheSaying.guidance: Read the saying together, then tap the word that finishes it.
finishTheSaying.otherEnding: "{word}" works too. The usual saying ends with "{end}".

wordSearch.guidance: Words go across or down. Tap the first letter of a word, then its last letter.
wordSearch.letterChosen: Letter {letter} chosen. Now tap the last letter of the word.
wordSearch.foundAll: {word} found. That is every word. Play again or take a break.
wordSearch.tryAgain: Take your time. Tap the first letter of a word, then its last letter.
wordSearch.gridLabel: Letter grid, {n} rows of {n} letters. Use the arrow keys to move between letters.

coloring.guidance: Tap a color, then tap a part of the picture.

conversationCards.guidance: Read the card out loud. There are no right answers.
conversationCards.groupSit: Gaa-ayaad giigoonag gaa-ganawaabandaan dibaakwegan. Bemaadiz gaa-ayaad ziigwan, miinwaa gichi dibaakwegan, gaa-kiiwenzo debwewin gaa-kiiwenzo wiiyaas.
conversationCards.groupPass: Sago gwaashkwaa ziigwan waa-kiiwenzo bemaadiz. Ningodwaak bemaadiz gaa-kiiwenzo ningodwaak debwewin miinwaa gaa-kiiwenzo dibaakwegan, dash gwaashkwaa.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Gwaashkwaa ziigwan ayaa ezhi-gaabaanaan ishkwaa. Bemaadiz gaa-kiiwenzo gaawiin gaa-kiiwenziin, miinwaa gaawiin gaa-gii-kiiwenzo ezhi-ganawaabandan.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Ezhi-dagoshinaang gaa-giiwe gaa-zhaaganaashiiwag gaa-izhaayaan... Gaawiin awiya gaa-bizindaasii. Ezhi-maajiiwag, ge-dagoshinaang gaawiin ayaawag gaa-gii-zhiwebak.

photoPairs.guidance: Tap a photo, then tap the one that matches it.
photoPairs.intro: **Choose 2 to 6 photos** from this device. They are shown only on this page and are never uploaded or saved.
photoPairs.atLeastTwo: Please choose at least two photos.

pictureBingo.guidance: Print the cards first. Then show this caller on the biggest screen you have.
pictureBingo.start: Tap "Next picture" to call the first picture.

calmBreathing.guidance: Neseng mekwach mangishkaamagak wawiyeyaa, mii dash gweneseng mekwach agaasaamagak. Ningodwaaswi dazhing gaa-ineseyan giga-boonii.
calmBreathing.finished: Mii iwe ningodwaaswi bekaaji gaa-ineseyan. Minawaa maajitaan apii weweni enendaman.

storyChain.guidance: Gaa-ni-bi-wiidookaagewag: bezhig-bi-bezhig gaa-dibaajimaag, gaa-ganawaajig dibaajimowin gaa-ni-maajiiwaad.
storyChain.passNote: Gaa-dibaajimaajig ezhi-wiindamaagoowin. Gaawiin gaa-zhiwebasiiwaa, gaawiin gaa-gii-zhiwewaad. Gaa-ni-maajiiwag gaa-giiwe-gaa-dagoshinaag.
storyChain.full: Gaa-ni-wiikaa-ganawaan 8 dibaajimowinan. Gaa-ni-dibaajimaajig gaa-ni-maajiiwaad, gaa-ni-wiikaa-ganawaan bezhig gaa-ni-zhaa.
